purpose: PRE-REGISTERED selection rule for a replacement comparator meta (Mahmood 5 Oct: 'pick an achievable comparator'). Committed BEFORE any candidate search; candidates are judged per criterion from their own text, and the pick follows from the criteria and tie-breaks alone. How our pool compares with any candidate is NOT an input.

protocol_reference.population: older adults (>=70 years) without established cardiovascular disease (primary prevention)

criteria.pass_if: the meta's full text is openly available from a legitimate open source (PMC open-access subset, or the publisher under an open licence); evidence: the licence statement or the PMC OA flag
the meta pools randomised controlled trials only (its own eligibility/methods statement); a meta that pools observational studies in the analysis used fails
the pooled comparison is statin vs placebo or control (usual care / no statin); statin-vs-statin or dose comparisons fail

the pooled analysis is restricted to primary prevention (no established cardiovascular disease, or a separately reported primary-prevention analysis) in older adults defined by an age cut-off of at least 65 or at least 70 years
it pools a major vascular / major (adverse) cardiovascular events composite (topic primary_outcome keywords)
it prints per-trial rows for that outcome (a table, or a forest plot with counts or effects) AND a pooled result for it

tie_breaks.score: outcome: 2 = 'major vascular events' or a MACE composite named as such; 1 = another cardiovascular-events composite. Plus estimand: 1 = RR; 0 = OR / HR / other
publication year, then month when years tie
number of trials in the pooled analysis of the protocol outcome

if_none_pass: NO_ACHIEVABLE_COMPARATOR: the topic keeps its current comparator and the finding is reported; no criterion is relaxed after the search
selector: scripts/g1_comparator_select.py (deterministic; reads this rule and the typed candidates file)
